label: AB12C_cF56_216_a_h_c-001
title: $\beta$ (high) Cristobalite AlPO$_{4}$ Structure
comments:
This is the AlPO$_{4}$ analog of \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_cF24_227_c_a-001}{$C9$ SiO$_{2}$ $\beta$ cristobalite}.  It transforms to the the orthorhombic \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oC24_20_a_2c_b-001}{$\alpha$ (low)} structure at a temperature near 500K (Hatch, 1994). 
 The oxygen (48h) sites are only 1/3 filled.  If replaced them by an averaged (16e) (x,x,x) site with x $\approx$ 0.136 we would obtain the ideal structure analogous to $C9$ SiO$_{2}$, but the Al-O and P-O distances would be slightly too small. 
 For more information, see our \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{silica and aluminum phosphate page}.
